description: This test verifies that the user can navigate to the documentation page from the footer and access relevant resources.
steps: Scroll to the footer section of the page.
Locate the 'Documentation' link using its stable selector.
Ensure that the documentation page loads successfully.
Verify the presence of key documentation sections.
expected_results: User is redirected to the documentation page.
Key documentation sections are accessible and visible.
edge_cases: Slow page load due to large content.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the documentation page.
dependencies: Footer link must be present on the landing page.
Documentation page must be live and operational.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the documentation page.
accessibility_requirements: Footer links should be keyboard accessible.
Documentation page should support screen readers.
